_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Declared options of the Baseline 1 mission (openamrobot_build1_scene/baseline1.py). Proposed for Alex and Mohamed, 20 Nov 2026; a change is a reviewed change of this file. Simulation evidence only.

cancel_check._comment: baseline1_cancel.py. On only when BASELINE1_CANCEL_CHECK=1 (the acceptance workflow sets it). At the start of nav_to_station: one short NavigateToPose goal straight ahead of the spawn pose on open floor (not needed by the mission), cancelled through the public action once the base has moved cancel_at_m, then the base must stay still. The mission then continues with the station goal from where the base stopped. Values Proposed; the stop bounds reuse scn07_cancel_resume where one exists.

retreat._comment: station_departure.py. BASELINE1_RETREAT selects how the retreat phase leaves the station; the default 'backup' is today's Nav2 behavior_server backup (unchanged). 'departure' and 'forward' are prepared alternatives, not enabled: Alex decides. Proposed 20 Nov 2026, simulation only.

departure._comment: A declared station departure: one straight move back, only in the retreat phase, published by the test harness on cmd_vel_smoothed (collision_monitor's input, below velocity_smoother) on the integration branch. Allowed only when the Nav2 configuration has no reverse path, so it is the one reverse of the run.

forward._comment: Turn in place by turn_rad with Nav2's spin behaviour, then a forward NavigateToPose goal forward_m ahead. turn_clearance_measured_m is the smallest shelf clearance of an in-place half turn measured by openamr-upperbody-sw #93 (b4e46dd): closed shelf, base 0.088 m past the station, arms in park, lift L1000. Geometry only. The forward goal uses #164's station tree (station goal checker 0.025 m); the default checker's 0.35 m would accept a 0.30 m goal before the base moves.
